problem_text:
A construction project requires 7 specialized teams to complete 7 distinct building phases.

Each phase consists of a sequence of tasks represented as pairs (Team, Duration),
where each pair specifies the team responsible for the task and the number of days needed to complete it.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the tasks must be performed.

Phase details:
* Phase 1 requires the sequence: (Team4, 5) → (Team5, 3) → (Team1, 6) → (Team3, 2) → (Team2, 3) → (Team6, 1) → (Team7, 3)
* Phase 2 requires the sequence: (Team5, 2) → (Team7, 8) → (Team2, 9) → (Team1, 6) → (Team4, 6) → (Team6, 2) → (Team3, 1)
* Phase 3 requires the sequence: (Team2, 8) → (Team7, 6) → (Team4, 9) → (Team3, 6) → (Team6, 2) → (Team1, 2) → (Team5, 5)
* Phase 4 requires the sequence: (Team5, 5) → (Team4, 4) → (Team2, 8) → (Team3, 6) → (Team7, 5) → (Team1, 7) → (Team6, 10)
* Phase 5 requires the sequence: (Team2, 6) → (Team1, 6) → (Team4, 7) → (Team3, 5) → (Team5, 6) → (Team7, 7) → (Team6, 5)
* Phase 6 requires the sequence: (Team7, 6) → (Team1, 4) → (Team4, 3) → (Team3, 6) → (Team6, 8) → (Team2, 4) → (Team5, 2)
* Phase 7 requires the sequence: (Team6, 7) → (Team4, 9) → (Team7, 5) → (Team5, 8) → (Team3, 4) → (Team2, 6) → (Team1, 9)

Each task must be completed without interruption once it begins,
and each team can only work on one task at a time.
The objective is to determine the scheduling order of all tasks across the teams
so that the overall project completion time is minimized.
